value.rationale: Canonical real l1 and l-infinity norms of cut/cycle projections are natural edge-flow amplification and Banach complementability invariants. Their all-profile classification on arbitrary unequal complete multipartite graphs is not an arbitrary numerical slice: it reduces a full matrix norm to two class-size scores, proves a largest-parts rule for the cut projection, and exhibits an infinite family with opposite cycle-projection maximizing edge orbits. No optimality among all nonorthogonal projections or major downstream theorem is claimed.
